rows.label: qst650601_msg0002
rows.name: Three armed lifeforms are hiding here.

rows.label: qst650601_msg0003
rows.name:
Amazing, M.O.M.O.!
You really do have keen
observation abilities!

rows.label: qst650601_msg0004
rows.name:
You idiots! We know you're there!
Get out here already!

rows.label: qst650601_msg0005
rows.name: How the hell did they spot us?

rows.label: qst650601_msg0006
rows.name:
Boss, these guys have brought
a whole lot of Blades with them!

rows.label: qst650601_msg0008
rows.name:
I see. Then we'll take their money
and the Blades along with it.

rows.label: qst650601_msg0009
rows.name:
Whoa, did you hear
what those guys just said?

rows.label: qst650601_msg0010
rows.name:
They're declaring their intention
to kill the Drivers.

rows.label: qst650601_msg0011
rows.name:
They'll have to pay
for that arrogance.
